text: What is the '{name}' consideration?
hint:
Provide a description of this planning consideration.
            The common name for the planning consideration should be used here

text: Do we understand the lifecycle of a {name}?
Do we understand how the data is created/produced?
hint: What is the recipe? How do we think the publisher does this?

text: Where will or should the data be used?
hint: Where do we expect the data to be used and for what purpose.

text: Is there legislation that defines '{name}'?
hint: Tell us where it is

text: Who asked for '{name}' data?
hint: Give a specific name and role. E.g. Eloise, policy.

text: What is the legislation that defines '{name}'?
hint: We are looking for the legislation that specifically sets what the consideration is and why it matters in planning.

text: What needs to be done because {name} has acted as the trigger?
Who, in law, is responsible for the planning consideration or makes decisions about '{name}'?
hint: We are looking for the legislation that imposes this accountability on an organisation

text: Is the {name} a trigger?
hint: Considerations can trigger a need to do something or a series of things.

text: Is the {name} something to consult during plan making?
hint: Some considerations are consulted when performing tasks within the planning system.

text: Provide information about when {name} is used during plan making
hint: Some considerations are consulted when performing tasks within the planning system.

text: Will a data standard be required?
hint: We want to flag if we think we'll need to aggregate data from multiple providers.

text: Is there any {name} data already available?
What {name} data is currently available?
hint: Capture examples of any data currently available.

text: Do we think the data should come from a single source?
hint: Some datasets should be published by a single organisation.

text: What is the specific part of the legislation that requires the publication of '{name}'?
hint:
We are looking for the legislation that specifically
            mentions data/registers or other

text: Document a stage of the high-level lifecycle of a {name}
hint: Provide details of the stage

text: Other than the statutory consultees who are the primary users of {name}? How do we expect them to use {name}?
hint: List the actor or actors affected by the planning consideration, include how we expect each actor to actually use the data, what will they do with it and why?

text: Who are the types of users who might benefit from having access to {name} data?
hint: These are actors who may find the data useful, but are not the statutory user.

text: What are some potential uses of {name} data?
What's the value of adding {name} data to the platform?
hint: Is there value in DLUHC investing time and effort in getting the data ready and re-publishing?

text: Which 2024 focus area does the request support?
choices: {"Modern planning software","Faster local plans","Included in LURA",Other}

text: What is the driver for the request?
choices: {"National policy change","Ministerial priority","Specific user requirement","LPA requirement","Existing planning requirement",Other}

text: What is the specific part of the legislation that describes how a '{name}' gets designated?
hint:
We are looking for the legislation that specifically sets out who,
            where applicable, are the parties who are able to designate the planning consideration

text: What other planning considerations does it interact with?
hint: List the planning considerations it interacts with. Try to explain how.

text: Who are the statutory consultees for {name}?
hint: Create a list of the consultees and link to information about them where appropriate

text: From what we have learnt so far are there any risks to making {name} data available?
hint: This could be things like, the multiple sources of data, unclear licensing, lack of legislative driver, poor data quality, poorly defined requirements, ongoing costs on LPA, DLUHC etc.

text: What are the planning needs for this data?
hint: Either capture the needs here or link to where the needs have been recorded.
